settings.text: Collector-grade Philodendron, Alocasia, Monstera and Anthurium — rooted, acclimated and shipped Canada-wide.
Four families we know inside out — browse the one you're collecting.
Grown from a parent plant in a sterile lab — pest-free, disease-free and true to type. It's how we can offer collector aroids that are otherwise almost impossible to find in Canada.
Rooted and acclimated. Ships in 1–3 business days.
Reserved from our next lab batch, at a lower price.

If your plant doesn’t pull through within 30 days of delivery, we replace it — free on plants under $200, and at 50% of what you paid above that. All we ask is that you photograph it the day it arrives.
